{
  "summary": "The function processes an input byte array and returns a 32-bit value based on a bitwise transformation algorithm.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_01",
  "algorithm": "unknown",
  "self_confidence": 0.95,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "user_0",
      "type": "ALG",
      "text": "Applies a bitwise transformation to each byte in the input array.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "user_1",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Processes each byte in the input array sequentially.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "user_2",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns 0 when the input length is 0.",
      "asserted_values": ["0"],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "user_3",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the bitwise complement of a 32-bit value when the input length is non-zero.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xffffffff"],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "user_4",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not modify the input array.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "user_5",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0xedb88320 in the bitwise transformation.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xedb88320"],
      "confidence": 0.95
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint32_t fn_01(const uint8_t *in, size_t len) {\n  uint32_t result = 0;\n  if (len != 0) {\n    const uint8_t *ptr = in;\n    while (ptr != in + len) {\n      uint32_t val = *ptr;\n      uint32_t temp = 0xedb88320;\n      for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {\n        temp = -(temp & 1) & 0xedb88320 ^ temp >> 1;\n        val = val >> 1;\n      }\n      result ^= val;\n      ptr++;\n    }\n    return ~result;\n  }\n  return 0;\n}"
}
